reviews.text: Très bon masque généreux en sérum et qui apporte un effet réfrigérant au départ et beaucoup d'hydratation.il laisse la peau fraîche et raffermie.
reviews.zh: 非常好嘅面膜，精華好豐富，一開始有清涼感，補水效果好多。用完皮膚清新、緊緻。

reviews.text: bought it to restock my roundlab mask as part of my night time skincare routine. it having mugwort extract and madecassoside to replenish skin’s moisture and reduce irritation is a plus and must for my skincare routine😆
reviews.zh: 我買咗呢款去補充 Round Lab 面膜，作為晚上護膚程序嘅一部分。佢含有艾草提取物同 madecassoside，可以補充皮膚水分、減少刺激，係我護膚程序嘅加分同必備嘢 😆

reviews.text: Am trying alternatives to the I’m from mugwort mask and I’ve really liked the roundlab version. It has a nice ingredients list (actually I prefer the ingredients lists of both the alternatives more than the I’m from version). in effect though they are all really good for cooling and soothing the skin so I’d recommend you try them and see for yourselves.
reviews.zh: 我而家試緊 I'm from mugwort 面膜嘅替代品，我好鍾意 roundlab 嗰款。佢嘅成分表幾好（其實我覺得兩款替代品嘅成分表都比 I'm from 嗰款好）。不過效果上，佢哋全部都真係好好咁清涼同舒緩皮膚，所以我建議你試吓，自己睇吓。

reviews.text: I love these! 5/5 stars for the amazing calming effect. They are my go-to whenever my skin feels stressed or sensitive. The quality of the Round Lab masks is always top-notch, and this Mugwort version is no exception
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢啲！舒緩效果好正，俾 5 粒星。每當我皮膚覺得有壓力或者敏感，我一定會用佢哋。Round Lab 面膜嘅質素一向都係頂級，呢款艾草版本都一樣。

reviews.text: son buenas, cumplen con su función, dejan la piel muy hidratada y calma rojeces de manera inmediata. me encanta para preparar la piel
reviews.zh: 好好，夠功效，令皮膚好水潤，即時舒緩泛紅。我好鍾意用嚟為皮膚做準備。

reviews.text: After a hot summer day or just to unwind from the harsh wind outside during winter - this mask is calming and soothing. Highly recommended!
reviews.zh: 炎夏過後，或者冬天被外面嘅大風吹過之後，用呢款面膜去放鬆一下都好舒緩、平靜。極力推薦！

reviews.text: This mask has a light, gel-like texture that sticks really well to the skin. 🌱 It’s packed with mugwort, which helps calm redness, soothe irritation, and balance the skin. After using it, my skin feels soft, relaxed, and refreshed — smooth and cared-for without any sticky residue. Perfect for days when my skin feels stressed or sensitive, it’s like an instant little rescue 💕
reviews.zh: 呢款面膜質地輕盈、似啫喱，好貼服皮膚。🌱 佢含有大量艾草，有助舒緩泛紅、減輕刺激，並平衡皮膚。用完之後，皮膚感覺柔軟、放鬆、清新——光滑、被照顧好，冇黏膩殘留。當皮膚覺得有壓力或者敏感嗰啲日子就最啱，好似即時嘅小救星 💕

reviews.text:
I use it after outing on a sunny day to prevent my skin get irritated by too much sun exposure.
It's very calming and soothing.
reviews.zh:
我喺大太陽出街之後用，以防皮膚因為曬太多太陽而受刺激。
佢好舒緩、好鎮靜。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
